verdict.rationale: Cake documents an MCP integration that lets Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client ask about the live cap table in plain English, covering shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes. It is explicitly read-only, so natural-language use covers querying the product, not operating it through commands. Missing for 10: natural-language write/action commands (issuing grants, recording transactions, running workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the MCP integration works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client to Cake and ask about your Cap Table in plain English.
Ask your AI assistant about shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes - answered from your live Cap Table in Cake. All read-only.
